motion_rule: the rolling hook carries her and the beam across frame every beat and neither ever stops; sacks and crates sweep past the lens; the camera tracks alongside; new shot size each beat, never wider than her muzzle on a third of frame; ONE sideways move per beat, never up or down
character: a wiry macaque hanging by her tail from a rolling overhead hook, exactly two arms and no more, muzzle and jaw always clear
second_characters: ONE rat porter, a step from the lens, working wide in every beat, riding the rolling beam from 3.40, never touching her
props: ONE brass balance beam on that same rolling hook, two identical pans; TWO sacks, same cloth, same size, ДОЛГИ on the left, ИПОТЕКА on the right; A SWARM of loose papers
prop_continuity: both sacks stay the same size and cloth, only the writing differs; the pans never part from level after 2.40
environment: a packed store row, sacks and crates tight both sides, daylight from the roof, no far wall
light_events: flat white noon off the boards, a side shaft on the flying papers

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a level pleased female voice, biting off each word, 4.2 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ba-LANS, so-SHOL-sya, PROS-to, o-BE-ikh, sto-RON, dol-GI
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.20 and 1.20-3.40 each one breath, first word at 0.00; after 3.40 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable
audio.sfx: hook on the rail, paper wads flapping, a long suck of air

timeline.a: the hook drives her into frame, the beam rolling beside her, a sack swinging from each hand
she drops the left sack into the near pan without stopping, the row tearing past
she kicks off a stack going past
she swings the right sack across frame into the far pan
both pans settle dead level and ride past the lens side by side
she throws both hands out empty, the beam level, her muzzle clear
the rat lands on the rolling beam a step from the lens and swings the near sack across frame with him
that sack bursts against the beam on the swing and a wad of papers blows past the lens
he rides the beam its whole length past the lens, she drives on under him
he swings the far sack across frame the same way and it bursts open on the swing
the same papers blow out of that one into the lens, both sacks sweeping bare
the beam rides level between them, she drives her muzzle at the lens, her face not changing
the rat drops off and runs back the other way past the lens, papers whipping after him
still rolling she tips both pans at the lens and papers pour out of both at once
the papers sweep the row past the lens, both sacks bare on the level beam
the hook drives her into the lens, the beam level beside her, her face not changing

must_appear: she has two arms and no more in every beat, her tail is her only hold on the hook; the beam hangs from that moving hook and never touches down; the rat opens both sacks on the swing and the same papers blow out of each; the pans stay dead level from 2.40 to the last frame; at 6.60 and 9.30 her muzzle is at the lens, her face not changing; every word spoken, the last by 3.40
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a static camera, a still background, a sack opened in place, digits, slow motion, a closed jaw while speaking, a hero moving up or down the frame, extra limbs, a third arm, a balance standing on the ground, a counter, a third sack, multiple monkeys, a hero taken off the hook
